note: THE TRAP, AS A RESULT BODY: a finished picture whose FILE is 16:9 while the body reports whatever it likes. image-to-video has no aspect_ratio field, so a landscape keyframe yields a landscape clip with no error (D-019, D-028). Check 12 serves this with the landscape file and asserts the call fails naming the entry. The width and height below are the RIGHT ones on purpose — an adapter that read them instead of the file would pass, and that is the break this fixture exists to catch.

body.prompt: a keyframe that is not vertical
